summary: Frontend-only regression of iteration-53 changes (locked gates/UNLOCK ME sign, iPhone install flow, Jam Session phone-landscape, plaza/campus assets, name prompt, Shred/Clubhouse intro cards at 844x345). Nearly all passed. One real bug: on Jam Session the Guitar tab overflows the viewport at 844x345 (bottom 380px; BEND bar cut off and the page scrolls). Jelly Bells at 844x345 runs 2px past the bottom (minor).

ui_bugs.issue: guitar-instrument rect is top 106 / bottom 380 with viewport 345, so the BEND bar and the bottom of the note-button row are clipped and documentElement.scrollHeight=380. The cause is the fixed `[data-testid=guitar-instrument]{zoom:0.56}` in the max-height:520px landscape block: it doesn't scale with height, and 274px of guitar plus the 106px toolbar offset doesn't fit in 345. At 844x390 it fits (bottom 380 <= 390).
The bottom bell's rect bottom is 347 (2px past the viewport) and scrollHeight=347. Cosmetic, but the 'nothing below the viewport' criterion fails.

issues: The card fills 10-334px and scrolls inside itself. The 'Got it!' button's bottom edge is cut by the card's overflow, and md: text sizes kick in at 844 width. It still works (scroll + click), but tightening it for short landscape would look cleaner.
The 'Let's find them!' button bottom (336) sits about 1px past the card's inner bottom (335), so the button's shadow is slightly clipped. It is clickable.
The page scrolls to 850px because jam-controls-hint sits below the fold (desktop only, minor).

action_items: Fix the Guitar tab fit at 844x345: replace the fixed zoom:0.56 with a height-aware scale (e.g. reuse useFitScale/ResponsiveScaler, or add a max-height:400px media rule with a smaller zoom ~0.45) so guitar-instrument bottom <= viewport.
Trim Jelly Bells at max-height ~360px by a few px (e.g. reduce .jam-main padding-top or the jelly-bells-row width) so the bottom bell stays inside the viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css landscape block: guitar uses a static zoom while xylophone/piano use ResponsiveScaler. That inconsistency is the root cause of the guitar overflow.

The review request's zone mapping is off: jam-session.png and song-studio.png are in zone=create (not play), and sight-reading.png is in zone=play (not learn), per data/campus.js. All of them load fine in their real zones. This is not an app bug.
The agent note says the name-prompt skip is session-scoped, but PlayerNamePrompt actually saves jma_player_name_skipped_v1 in localStorage, so skip persists across reloads.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (24/26 checks; failures: Guitar overflow @844x345, Jelly Bells 2px @844x345)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified PASS: fresh profile at 1920x800 has gate-learn and gate-create data-locked=true, closed-sign text 'UNLOCK ME!', lock pill 'Earn 1 badge to open', 0 '-rope' elements; clicking a locked gate opens plaza-quests-modal (absent at 300ms, present by 1.5s). The quests modal fits at 844x345. Desktop fullscreen-button aria-label is 'Go fullscreen' and no install-nudge appears. iPhone emulation via page.context.add_init_script plus ctx.new_page() works: aria-label 'How to make JMA full screen', nudge appears, click opens install-card and sets jma_install_nudge_seen='1', install-card-done closes it, reload shows no nudge, fullscreen-button reopens the card, install-card-close closes it. Assets on Home: gate-play.png (906w), crt-tv.png (1024w, scaleX(-1)), dressing-room.png (scaleX(-1)). All campus zone images load with no broken images. Key hints: 0 visible at 844x390/345 on all tabs; 8/8/7 visible at 1920x800 on bells/xylo/piano/drums. Name prompt card at 844x345 spans 66-280px and the skip link works. Shred: shred-start-btn starts at 340-400px, scrolls into view and click shows shred-ready-count. Clubhouse: clubhouse-intro-go click closes the card. Tooling note: the browser_automation tool failed on f-strings that contain inner quotes, and str() is shadowed, so use plain concatenation.
